text:
Last week, the lounge crew read your second message with care, and we are sorry that your trip with your companion animal felt unsettled and poorly handled. You wrote to us because the missed connection left you frustrated, worried about your pet, and disappointed in the way our team communicated during the disruption.

We have reviewed the file and spoken with the staff involved. The situation should have been explained more clearly, and we understand why the delay in support made the day harder. Our handlers are trained to use calm, humane methods around animals, and the cabin team is expected to keep a close watch on them throughout the journey. When a transfer goes off track, the passenger coordinator should also step in with clear guidance so that you are not left guessing about next steps.

<<FACT F110>>

We know that a missed connection can turn a careful travel plan into a very stressful experience, especially when a pet is involved. Even so, please know that Aurelia Skyways takes these concerns seriously and uses them to improve service across the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Thank you for bringing this to our attention and giving us a chance to respond more carefully.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
